title: Expert Network Market Valued at $4.65B in 2026, on Track for $17B by 2035
summary: New market research estimates the global expert network market at $4.65 billion in 2026, up from $4.19B in 2025. The industry is projected to reach $16.9–18B by 2034–2035 at a 15–16% CAGR. Consulting firms account for nearly half of total spend, with AI-enabled sourcing now offered by over 30% of platforms, cutting expert identification time by 50%.
